name: playwright-ai-workflow-kit
description: AI-assisted workflow kit for planning, implementing, reviewing, auditing, and maintaining Playwright automation projects.

scripts.test: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --results && node scripts/ensure-playwright-browsers.mjs && npx playwright test --project=api --project=ui-chromium --project=e2e --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:ui: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --results && node scripts/ensure-playwright-browsers.mjs && npx playwright test --project=ui-chromium --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --results && node scripts/ensure-playwright-browsers.mjs && npx playwright test --project=e2e --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:smoke: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --results && node scripts/ensure-playwright-browsers.mjs && npx playwright test --project=api --project=ui-chromium --project=e2e --grep @smoke --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:regression: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --results && node scripts/ensure-playwright-browsers.mjs && npx playwright test --project=api --project=ui-chromium --project=e2e --grep @regression --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:visual: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --results && node scripts/ensure-playwright-browsers.mjs && npx playwright test --project=ui-chromium --grep @visual --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:cross-browser: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --results && node scripts/ensure-playwright-browsers.mjs && npx playwright test --project=ui-chromium --project=ui-firefox --project=ui-webkit --grep @cross-browser --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:responsive: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --results && node scripts/ensure-playwright-browsers.mjs && npx playwright test --project=ui-mobile-chromium --grep @responsive --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.report:allure:generate: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --html && allure generate reports/allure/results --config reports/allure/allurerc.mjs
scripts.report:allure:serve: node scripts/clean-allure-artifacts.mjs --html && allure generate reports/allure/results --config reports/allure/allurerc.mjs --open
